business_problem: BS Brodnica wanted to attract and onboard more commercial banking customers, but repetitive support questions and product guidance were consuming consultant and contact-center time and made it harder to deliver instant, high-quality service.
solution_summary: BS Brodnica worked with TUATARA to launch Piotr, a virtual assistant built on TUATARA's Actionbot framework and powered by IBM watsonx Assistant. The assistant was designed to fit directly into the bank's customer-service workflow rather than operate as a standalone demo: TUATARA integrated Piotr with the bank's knowledge base so answers stay current, added multichannel automation so customers can ask questions digitally at any time, and used agile workshops plus testing on real customer data to refine responses before production. In operation, watsonx Assistant handles natural-language understanding, Piotr answers common banking questions, promotes relevant services when the interaction fits, helps users complete tasks such as filling digital application forms, and transfers more complex cases to employees. The result is a 24x7 service layer that reduces frontline workload while preserving continuity into human support.

solution_components.name: Actionbot
solution_components.role: Provides the virtual-assistant framework and multichannel integration layer that TUATARA adapted for Piotr.

solution_components.name: IBM watsonx Assistant
solution_components.role: Interprets customer questions and powers the conversational logic behind Piotr's banking support flows.

data_flow: Online customer questions enter Piotr through Actionbot, watsonx Assistant interprets the request, the assistant uses the bank's knowledge base to return an answer or promote a relevant service, and complex cases are transferred directly to a bank employee with the interaction continuing in the same workflow.
business_outcome: BS Brodnica created always-on support, reduced repetitive work for consultants, improved responsiveness for existing customers, and opened more room for commercial teams to focus on high-value conversations and cross-sell opportunities.
metrics: over 3,700 messages in the first two months
